characters.name: Shareena Wickett
characters.description: The main protagonist of the series. She is a tomboyish Goth-dressed girl who prefers to be a free spirit and finds pleasure in the sublime. Dark Is Not Evil: She wears black, but she's a nice person. Hates Wearing Dresses: As shown in "Shareena Takes The Cake". Little Miss Snarker: She is only twelve years old and easily the snarkiest out of the group. Only Sane Woman: She often feels needed in this role at times, especially when dealing with Emmitt, Jim, Gug, and/or Shelley.

characters.name: Emmitt Roswell
characters.description: A blond-haired boy who is a conspiracy theorist. He tends to believe that aliens exist in outer space and often tries to make contact with them, much to the dismay of others. Conspiracy Theorist: He comes up with absurd conspiracy theories and spends all day investigating them. Meaningful Name: His last name is "Roswell". Red Is Heroic: He wears a red sweater, and he's one of the main protagonists. Youthful Freckles: He sports freckles on his cheeks.

characters.name: Jim Kim
characters.description: A shy kid who has an obsession with comic book superheroes, particularly the DC superheroes. Acting Out a Daydream: Sometimes he is so deeply invested in his superhero fantasies that he acts them out, which results in him getting detention. Animal Lover: His Kids WB profile states that he has a pet dog. Loony Fan: He quotes comic books in casual conversation, and he bases his plans on comic book stories. Shrinking Violet: He's quite shy, and his Kids WB profile states that he wants to be less shy.

characters.name: Ramone "Gug" Gugleamo
characters.description: A pint-sized, short-tempered Hispanic boy who constantly tries to pick fights with bigger kids. Catchphrase: "Let me at 'er! Let me at 'er!" whenever Kisskillya provokes him. One of the kids always has to restrain him by the back collar when he says this. Hot-Blooded: He tends to pick fights with other students. Let Me at Him!: The other kids have to hold him back from fighting his latest enemy. Kisskillya is his most frequent target. The Napoleon: He's the shortest kid in detention and also very aggressive.

characters.name: Duncan Bubble
characters.description: A mute boy who communicates using his yo-yo. Companion Cube: His yo-yo, which he uses to spell out messages and get himself and his friends out of trouble. Meaningful Name: Named after the Duncan yo-yo company. Non-Standard Character Design: His narrow head and large nose make him stand out amongst the other characters. In fact, he looks like he could beFerb's distant cousin. The Speechless: He never speaks a word and as mentioned above, he uses his yo-yo to spell out messages.

characters.name: Lemonjella and OrangejellaLaBelle
characters.description: Genius African-American twins with competitive streaks against each other. Their names are pronounced "lem-ON-juh-la" and "or-AN-juh-la", respectively. Black and Nerdy: They're the smartest kids in the group by far. It's also subverted because they're more fashionable and less socially awkward than Shelley, the resident nerd. Edible Theme Naming: Their names are one letter away from "Lemon Jell-O" and "Orange Jell-O".noteTheir names are also a reference to anUrban Legendabout twins named "Lemonjello" and "Orangejello". To this day, there are people who claim to have met these twins, despite no evidence of them existing.Accordingly, Lemonjella wears a yellow shirt, while Orangejella wears orange pants. Facial Profiling: They have large lips, and in some shots, their lips are big enough to cover their chins. Playful Hacker: They once got detention by hacking into the school's computer system to erase library fines.

characters.name: Shelley Kelly
characters.description: Kisskillya's assistant, a cheerful, enthusiastic teacher's pet who kisses up to Kisskillya. All Love Is Unrequited: She has a crush on Emmitt, who (like the rest of the group) thinks she is annoying. Foil: To Shareena. Shelley is very excitable, fond of following and enforcing rules, and likes the rigid structure of school, while Shareena is mellow and free-spirited. I Just Want to Have Friends: She likes being with the group and wants to be friends with them. In fact, she thinks Shareena is her best friend. Unfortunately, the other kids find her obnoxious due to her brown-nosing personality, and she often ends up on the receiving end of Shareena's snarky remarks. Scout-Out: She wears her Ladybug Scout uniform to school every day.

characters.name: Miss Eugenia P. Kisskillya
characters.description: The detention monitor and gym teacher at Benedict Arnold Middle School, who runs detention with an iron fist. Catchphrase: She yells "Deten-TION!" like a drill sergeant. Drill Sergeant Nasty: She treats the group like they're in boot camp, calling them "soldiers" and "privates". Unsurprisingly, she is a former Marine. Made of Iron: During "A Friend in Greed", she was able to survive falling down a cliff, catapulting into a tree branch, getting stung by a swarm of bees, being kicked by a moose, falling down another cliff, and landing on a bush full of poison oak. No wonder why she was in the Marines. Unexpected Kindness: In "Capitol Punishment", she is shown to be a fun and friendly tour guide as she takes Shareena on a tour of Washington, D.C., much to Shareena's surprise.
